title: #smallpoems Doxa of drums crash in a crescendo of One, phenomena pantomiming animistic agents who dance a true name summoning three emperors to court
summary: #smallpoems Doxa of drums crash in a crescendo of One, phenomena pantomiming animistic agents who dance a true name summoning three emperors to court as bellowing beats bounce between scattered entities in spheres of activity painted on hides pulled over the burl of dawn's day and hammer hits rock in stillness of constant hums
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems

Doxa of
drums
crash
in
a crescendo of
One,
phenomena
pantomiming
animistic
agents
who dance
a
true name
summoning
three emperors to
court
as bellowing
beats bounce
between
scattered entities
in spheres of activity
painted on hides
pulled over
the burl
of dawn's day
and hammer hits
rock in stillness
of constant
hums
